releases.name: opencode-bg-control v0.1.1
releases.body:
Relicensed under MIT starting with 0.1.1. The previous release, v0.1.0, remains GPL-3.0-only and unchanged.

No behavior changes from 0.1.0.

## Install

Add the package name to your OpenCode config; OpenCode installs it automatically via npm:

```json
{ "plugin": ["opencode-bg-control"] }
```

The `OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS=1` feature flag is mandatory and must be set before OpenCode starts.

## Tools

Five bounded tools for background Task subagents: `bg_list`, `bg_status`, `bg_result`, `bg_transcript`, `bg_cancel`.

All state is process-epoch scoped (memory-only, not durable across restarts) and read-only/observational except `bg_cancel`. Do not poll — these tools complement, not replace, OpenCode's built-in completion/failure notifications.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-bg-control

releases.name: opencode-bg-control v0.1.0
releases.body:
First public npm release of `opencode-bg-control`.

## Install

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-bg-control/v/0.1.0
- OpenCode config: `{"plugin":["opencode-bg-control"]}`
- Mandatory feature flag: `OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS=1`

## Tools

- `bg_list`
- `bg_status`
- `bg_result`
- `bg_cancel`
- `bg_transcript`

## Limitations

Task state is exact when tracked directly and inferred when recovered from observable runtime state. Tracking is limited to current OpenCode process epoch; jobs from earlier process epochs are unavailable. Plugin deliberately provides no polling or wait loop: use built-in completion notifications, then inspect terminal results.

## Validation

Clean package-name OpenCode auto-install and `bg_list` smoke passed (`ok:true`, `feature:enabled`).

License: GPL-3.0-only.

README npm-first installation improvements landed on `main` after release commit.
